title: Homework: Display Interfacing
text:
In this homework, you will build a small display dashboard using the provided device drivers.
The system uses:

MPU6050 IMU over I2C
HD44780 16x2 character LCD with an I2C backpack
ST7789 TFT display over SPI

The goal is not to write a full display library. The goal is to understand how simple display drivers are connected to an embedded application.






Note



Display modules can be borrowed from the laboratory. Use the provided drivers as your starting point.

title: Homework: Display Interfacing
text:
5.1 Part 1: CubeMX Configuration
Create a CubeIDE project for NUCLEO-F401RE.
Configure:



Peripheral
Required setting




I2C1
PB8 = SCL, PB9 = SDA, 100 kHz, 7-bit addressing


SPI1
Master transmit, 8-bit, CPOL low, CPHA 1 edge


USART2
115200 baud, 8N1


PA8
GPIO output, label TFT_RST


PA9
GPIO output, label TFT_DC


PA10
GPIO output, label TRACE



If the project reports linker errors for atan2f() or sqrtf(), add the math library:
Project Properties -> C/C++ Build -> Settings -> MCU GCC Linker -> Libraries -> add m

title: Homework: Display Interfacing
Homework: Display Interfacing
text:
5.3 Part 3: Required Display Behavior
Start from the provided app/app.c, then make these changes:

On the character LCD, show:

line 1: your name or group number
line 2: current roll or pitch angle

On the TFT, show:

a center reference mark or cross
a shape whose position changes when the board is tilted

Change the TFT shape color when the absolute tilt angle becomes large.

Example behavior:
Small tilt:   yellow square
Large tilt:   red square
Keep the code simple. You may use rectangles only; you do not need fonts, images, sprites, or DMA.

title: Homework: Display Interfacing
text:
5.4 Part 4: Short Code Explanation
Answer these questions in your report:

What does BSP_I2C_LCD_IMU represent?
Why can the MPU6050 and LCD backpack share the same I2C bus?
Why does the HD44780 LCD receive each byte as two nibbles?
What does st7789_fill_rect(x, y, w, h, color) do?
Why are we not using DMA in this homework?

title: Homework: Display Interfacing
text:
6.1 Measurement 1: I2C Bus Check
Instrument: DMM and serial terminal.
Record:



Item
Measured / observed value




SDA idle voltage



SCL idle voltage



MPU6050 address found



LCD backpack address found




Expected:

SDA and SCL idle near the I2C pull-up voltage: about 3.3 V for a 3.3 V backpack setup, or about 5 V when the LCD backpack is powered from the Nucleo 5V pin on Nucleo-F401RE PB8/PB9.
MPU6050 appears at 0x68.
LCD backpack appears at 0x27 or 0x3F.

title: Homework: Display Interfacing
text:
6.2 Measurement 2: TFT Redraw Timing
Instrument: oscilloscope on PA10 / TRACE.
Record:



Item
Value




TRACE high time for one redraw



Redraw period




The starter code sets TRACE high during TFT drawing and low after drawing.

title: Homework: Display Interfacing
text:
7.1 Wrong LCD Address Test
Temporarily change:
#define LCD_ADDR LCD_I2C_ADDR_27
to:
#define LCD_ADDR LCD_I2C_ADDR_3F
or reverse it, depending on your actual module.
Record:

What happened on the character LCD?
What did the UART log show?
How did you restore correct operation?

title: Homework: Display Interfacing
text:
6.3 Measurement 3: I2C Communication Capture
Instrument: logic analyzer.
Connect:



Logic analyzer channel
Signal




CH0
SCL / PB8


CH1
SDA / PB9


GND
Nucleo GND



Capture at least one I2C transaction after reset. Use the I2C decoder in the logic analyzer software.
Record:



Item
Observed value




Captured address 1



Captured address 2



ACK/NACK visible?



Approximate SCL frequency




Expected:

You should see traffic to the MPU6050 address 0x68.
You should see traffic to the LCD backpack address 0x27 or 0x3F.
The decoder should show ACKs for the connected devices.
